question: Is direction D012 already explored or contradicted: Narrow the programme to a claim-matched, dual-scored point-in-time retrieval study on amended legal clauses: version identity (was the returned passage in force at the target date) adjudicates retrieval-level claims, and answer accuracy restricted to the answer-differential stratum adjudicates user-visible harm, with citation-validity failure and the screen pass rate reported alongside, prevalence kept as a swept assumption, and no single aggregate score. The framework contribution is repositioned from a new retrieval mechanism to an implemented version-level benchmark plus the comparative evidence on whether published recency decay suffices; the valid-time gate is retained as the mechanism arm, with recency decay as the published comparison arm.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
